quotes.author: Cody A
quotes.text: Look no further This is your Guide! Brad picked us up at the dock. Unknow to us it was in the middle of a bass tournament with 200 other boats. Undertured he he put us on the fish. We were catching fish right in front of other boats. I can't say enough about his professionalism and attention to detail. His Ranger boat that's has the latest in equipment is truly a special pleasure to be on. If your looking for a true bass pro fishing experience he is it. He has a great attitude and personality that is passionate about fishing. Thanks Brad for a awesome experience!

quotes.author: Shawn Csicsek
quotes.text: We went on a guided trip in April of 2022 with Captain Brad and had a great time on the water. He put us on Bass all day and took us on a fun boat ride to show us the unique wildlife of the area. His 22 ft Ranger is loaded with all recent tech and enjoyable to ride in, with lots of room for fishing between the 3 of us total. Highly recommend fishing with Captain Brad if you want a quality fishing guide experience. Thanks Brad!

quotes.author: Art Miney
quotes.text: Capt Brad is hands down one of the best and most experienced guide I have had the pleasure of meeting and fishing with. He definitely knows the lake and passed down his knowledge to me that I will take back with me to my local lakes. I also had the pleasure of being with him when the caught a wooper of a 10.3 lb large mouth bass.

quotes.author: Mike Benak
quotes.text: Brad is a top guide. He knows what he is doing and his boat and equipment is outstanding. This is the 2 nd year I have fished the Harris Chain with him. I you want a professional guide and a Good time and catch Fish ask for Brad. You won’t be disappointed!

quotes.author: Greg Haddix
quotes.text: Had an awesome day on Harris Chain with Capt Brad. We all put the beat down on them with 29 fish. Steve's big fish was 5.1lbs. We had several over 4lbs and a lot of 2s and 3s. Enjoyed the day being onboard with Capt Brad, will do it again!

quotes.author: Mike Brunett
quotes.text: Have a great time with Brad, who was really helpful for me for a first time fisherman in the Harris chain of lakes. I would absolutely recommend him and use him again.
